svg.text: C · A segmented shelf: one 42.8 m folder as 5 consecutive 9 m segments
All segments have the folder's canonical path, a segment index and count, and one shared group id; any of them resolves to the same folder.
segments of 9 m: fixture = 2 side panels + books + spacing + breathing
segment 1/5: books 1–142 of 666, 8.9 m used of 9 m
segment 2/5: books 143–278 of 666, 9.0 m used of 9 m
segment 3/5: books 279–417 of 666, 8.9 m used of 9 m
segment 4/5: books 418–554 of 666, 8.9 m used of 9 m
segment 5/5: books 555–666 of 666, 7.5 m used of 9 m (display bay 1.5 m)
